# Quotation response -- KR-RFQ-2026-11

Visakoivu Oy -- technical maintenance services, Ryhtila production and office facility

## Eligibility

2.2 Electrical professionals employed in-house exceed the minimum of 15.

2.3 Qualifying reference: school-property maintenance framework for Keski-Vaaran kaupunki (REF05), EUR 1,450,000, among several comparable projects within the last five years.

2.4 Valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate held.

2.6 Turnover for FY2025 was EUR 20,300,000, above the EUR 5,000,000 threshold.

## Technical response

3.1 Environmental impacts during works, including waste, emissions and noise, are managed under our environmental management procedures.

3.3 Building envelope condition, including roofing and cladding, is assessed periodically as part of the maintenance scope.

3.4 Internal quality control and testing procedures apply to all completed maintenance and repair work, with records kept on file.

3.5 A warranty period is offered on equipment and materials installed under the agreement, stated in the pricing schedule.

3.7 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is programmed for the facility on the applicable statutory cycle.

3.8 Scheduled maintenance visits follow a defined content and frequency, confirmed with the Buyer's facilities contact at contract start.

3.10 Commissioning and testing follow a written protocol after equipment replacement, with results recorded for the Buyer.

3.12 Unresolved faults escalate to a named supervisor, then to management, within the agreed timeframe, with the Buyer kept informed.

3.13 Fire protection systems are tested and maintained on a defined schedule appropriate to each system type.

3.14 Continuity is maintained through cross-trained cover and handover documentation if key personnel change during the contract.

3.16 Common spare parts are held in stock, with lead times confirmed to the Buyer on request.

## Commercial terms

4.3 Invoicing is monthly and available electronically.

4.4 Subcontractor costs, where used, are made transparent to the Buyer on request.

4.6 A discount structure is proposed, scaling with order volume over the contract period.

## Forms enclosed

Subcontractor list (Liite 3); tender form (Liite 1); description of the quality system.

## Format

6.1 The quotation does not exceed 20 pages, excluding attachments.

6.2 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year.

6.3 All prices are quoted excluding VAT, in euro.

6.4 The submission deadline is noted in Finnish time.

6.6 The closing time is noted as the time the quotation is recorded as received by the Buyer, not the time it is sent.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

A.1 The office wing's passenger lift is maintained in compliance with applicable lift regulations.

A.4 Any subcontracted trades are selected and supervised under our standard management process.

A.7 Response times for corrective maintenance requests are stated separately from fault-response times.

## Liite B -- Kaupalliset ehdot

B.1 A bonus-malus arrangement is proposed against agreed service levels.

## Liite C -- Lomakkeet

Description of our environmental management system; power of attorney for the signatory, where applicable.

Visakoivu Oy
